inputText: This is Ayin — AH-yeen. Sound: silent in modern Israeli Hebrew, like Aleph. Shape hook: a lowercase y that sits on the floor: two arms from one low join, tail bent flat, right arm taller. Tip: Both arms grow from ONE spot down near the floor and nothing continues above or below that join (the tail just bends flat along the baseline); not Tsadi, Aleph.
